name: Regional care team
arc: The re-read. Headwinds. Recognition rung one fails to move the signal; rung two lands.
intendedStateNeeds: the Question 2 team-conditions bank. Headwinds needs an external majority among located negatives, and this bank carries 97 external against 367 internal with 51 of its 90 questions offering no external option at all. Headwinds is primarily fed by Question 2 and its design register (spec 4.5d).
